points.body: Regarding psychic waves and parallelism, I said that there are two things for auto-suggestion and outer suggestion.

points.title: Auto-suggestion is done through what?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Auto-suggestion is done through what?
summary: Auto-suggestion is done through what?
The incantation, what is it?
Is it an internal or external acoustic expression?
points.body: Auto-suggestion is done through what? Your own incantation. The incantation, what is it? Is it an internal or external acoustic expression?

points.title: When you say something, you [suppose] are saying, “Rama”, it is a vocal expression, ext…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: When you say something, you [suppose] are saying, “Rama”, it is a vocal expression, external expression
summary: When you say something, you [suppose] are saying, “Rama”, it is a vocal expression, external expression.
Just the internal vocal expression.
You say something internally.
points.body: When you say something, you [suppose] are saying, “Rama”, it is a vocal expression, external expression. So while using your incantation, what do you do? Just the internal vocal expression. When you think, what do you do? You say something internally.

points.title: What is thinking?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: What is thinking?
summary: To say something internally.
Just try to think something, to speak within your mind.
And when you speak externally, use the vocal cord externally, then others may hear.
points.body: What is thinking? To say something internally. To think means to speak within. Just try to think something, to speak within your mind. In that case, no one else will hear. And when you speak externally, use the vocal cord externally, then others may hear.

points.title: And there is a third style of expression
points.prompt: Define and explain: And there is a third style of expression
summary: And there is a third style of expression.
External vocal expression.
(Baba mouths the words “Rama”) You can hear, others can not.
points.body: And there is a third style of expression. There is external expression but only you can hear. It is called what? What is its name in Sanskrit? Upáḿshu. (speaks loudly). Ráma, Ráma, Ráma. External vocal expression. (Baba closes his eyes and pauses) Internal. (Baba mouths the words “Rama”) You can hear, others can not. Upáḿshu.

points.title: I told you in [[Tainan]] that actual progress is in spiritual level, not in physical or…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: I told you in [[Tainan]] that actual progress is in spiritual level, not in physical or psychic level
summary: I told you in [[Tainan]] that actual progress is in spiritual level, not in physical or psychic level.
It is auto-suggestion.
I used the word in DMC.
points.body: I told you in [[Tainan]] that actual progress is in spiritual level, not in physical or psychic level. Your progress is auto-suggestion or outer suggestion, when you say something like… “Sudarshan, be an ideal man. Sudarshan be an ideal man,” When you say internally, what is it? It is auto-suggestion. Sudarshan is giving suggestion to Sudarshan. The conscience goads Sudarshan's mind towards the idealistic stance of Sudarshan. – “Be an ideal man.” The mental picture is in the mind of Sudarshan. And the conscience of Sudarshan says, “Sudarshan, be an ideal man.” The conscience of Sudarshan goads towards that ideal figure. Do you follow the psychology? What is it? It is auto-suggestion. “I must be a good man. I must be a good boy. I must do something concrete for the world. I won't be afraid of anybody in this world. I must be a good boy. I must do something concrete for the world. No power in Heaven or Earth can check me.” What are these things? Auto-suggestion. I think now the term auto-suggeston is clear to you. I used the word in DMC.

points.title: When someone else is saying, “Sudarshan, be a good boy
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: When someone else is saying, “Sudarshan, be a good boy
summary: When someone else is saying, “Sudarshan, be a good boy.
Sudarshan, start your life afresh, forgetting all your past mistakes and misdeeds.
Suggestion coming from the outside.
points.body: When someone else is saying, “Sudarshan, be a good boy. Sudarshan, be an ideal man. Sudarshan, start your life afresh, forgetting all your past mistakes and misdeeds.” what are these things? Outer suggestion. Suggestion coming from the outside.

points.title: What is the best auto-suggestion, on what you are to do?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: What is the best auto-suggestion, on what you are to do?
summary: What is the best auto-suggestion, on what you are to do?
That is the best auto-suggestion.
Automatic-done by self.
points.body: What is the best auto-suggestion, on what you are to do? You are to use your incantation, always use your Iśt́a Mantra. That is the best auto-suggestion. Auto means what? Auto means self. Autonomy means self government. Automatic-done by self.

points.title: Then what is the best outer suggestion?
points.prompt: Define and explain: Then what is the best outer suggestion?
summary: Then what is the best outer suggestion?
This outer suggestion strengthens the vitality of auto-suggestion.
This outer suggestion is called Satsauṋga in Sanskrit.
points.body: Then what is the best outer suggestion? When you are in good company, from that good company there comes outer suggestion. Here you are getting outer suggestion. This outer suggestion strengthens the vitality of auto-suggestion. So, outer suggestion is a necessity, is indispensable for a man's spiritual progress. This outer suggestion is called Satsauṋga in Sanskrit.

points.title: What is Satsauṋga?
points.prompt: Define and explain: What is Satsauṋga?
summary: Have you understood what is outer suggestion?
In the case of outer suggestion, there will be good company and bad company.
Sadvipra, one who is a good intellectual.
points.body: What is Satsauṋga? Have you understood what is outer suggestion? So many good discussions are there. These discussions will have an effect on your mind – Effect of outer suggestion. Now all the company or all the associations can not give you outer suggestion. If you are in the company of thieves, they can say, “Steal, steal, go on stealing.” This is also a sort of outer suggestion. In case of auto-suggestion, you are sure that there will be cent per cent success because of that mantra, that incantation. In the case of outer suggestion, there will be good company and bad company. And the outer suggestion coming from bad company may be detrimental to your progress; and not only your progress, but the progress of the entire humanity. If you become a giant, then so many people will be destroyed by you. So there must be a careful selection of company. That is what in Sanskrit is called Satsauṋga. Sat means good, and sauṋga means association = Satsauṋga. Sadvipra, one who is a good intellectual.

points.title: What is good and what is bad?
points.prompt: Define and explain: What is good and what is bad?
summary: What is good and what is bad?
When good is established over bad, when the result goes in favour of good, that result is known as conscience, the authentic and established power of discrimination.
For conscience the Sanskrit term is Viveka.
points.body: What is good and what is bad? A constant fight is going on between good and bad. In your mind, in our society, in the country, in the entire human society. Never-ending fight between good and bad. When good is established over bad, when the result goes in favour of good, that result is known as conscience, the authentic and established power of discrimination. It is called conscience in Latin. As a result of fight between good and bad, when the resultant goes in favour of good, that resultant is called power of discrimination or conscience. The English meaning of conscience is power of discrimination. For conscience the Sanskrit term is Viveka.

points.title: Now, what is good and, bad?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Now, what is good and, bad?
summary: Now, what is good and, bad?
And your physical, psychic, or spiritual actions that increase the distance between you and your Lord is bad.
And when it is increased, it is bad.
points.body: Now, what is good and, bad? What is Sat and what is Asat? The physical, mental, or spiritual action that helps you, or your association in developing your spiritual life, that lessens the distance between you and your Lord is good. And your physical, psychic, or spiritual actions that increase the distance between you and your Lord is bad. That which encourages the proximity between you and your Lord, your goal, your idealistic goal, and the distance is decreased, lessened, is good. And when it is increased, it is bad.

points.title: So while selecting company, you should be careful whether its discourses, its activitie…
points.prompt: Define and explain: So while selecting company, you should be careful whether its discourses, its activities, its plans or programmes are to
summary: So while selecting company, you should be careful whether its discourses, its activities, its plans or programmes are to decrease the distance between you and your Lord.
Baoddhika Amitavyayitá.
That Satsauṋga will give you outer suggestion.
points.body: So while selecting company, you should be careful whether its discourses, its activities, its plans or programmes are to decrease the distance between you and your Lord. This is Satsauṋga, good company. Otherwise it is Asatsauṋga. Even intellectual discussions of a high order may not be Satsauṋga if it has got nothing to do with lessening the distance between you and your Lord, you and your Goal. That type of intellectual discourse, in my language is called intellectual extravaganza. Baoddhika Amitavyayitá. Satsauṋga and Asatsauṋga. When it goads you on the path of the Lord, it is Satsauṋga. From this moment, you should always try to have Satsauṋga. That Satsauṋga will give you outer suggestion.

points.title: Those who are engaged in Satsauṋga and lessening the distance between the Lord and the…
points.prompt: Define and explain: Those who are engaged in Satsauṋga and lessening the distance between the Lord and the aspirant, their actions are call
summary: Those who are engaged in Satsauṋga and lessening the distance between the Lord and the aspirant, their actions are called Puńya.
And those who try to increase the gap, their actions are known as Pátaka.
Puńya and Pátaka – virtue and vice.
points.body: Those who are engaged in Satsauṋga and lessening the distance between the Lord and the aspirant, their actions are called Puńya. And those who try to increase the gap, their actions are known as Pátaka. Puńya and Pátaka – virtue and vice.

points.title: In the scriptures, it is said, “Kuru Puńyam Ahorátram”

summary: In the scriptures, it is said, “Kuru Puńyam Ahorátram”
points.body: In the scriptures, it is said, “Kuru Puńyam Ahorátram”

summary: “You should always be engaged in doing Puńya.
“Ahoh” means sunrise to sunset, not to zero hours in the nights, sunrise to sunset.
Ahoratri means 24 hours.
points.body: “You should always be engaged in doing Puńya.” Ahorátram, day and night. “Ahoh” means sunrise to sunset, not to zero hours in the nights, sunrise to sunset. And “Rátri” means sunset to sunrise. Ahoratri means 24 hours.

points.title: You should be engaged in Puńyam – virtuous work – for all 24 hours
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: You should be engaged in Puńyam – virtuous work – for all 24 hours
summary: You should be engaged in Puńyam – virtuous work – for all 24 hours.
points.body: You should be engaged in Puńyam – virtuous work – for all 24 hours.

points.title: You may ask, “How can I do Puńyam while sleeping?
points.prompt: Explain the contrast: You may ask, “How can I do Puńyam while sleeping?
summary: You may ask, “How can I do Puńyam while sleeping?
But while sleeping, how can I do Puńyam?
When habit becomes one with your existence, it is called nature.
points.body: You may ask, “How can I do Puńyam while sleeping? In the wakeful state, I may do Puńyam. But while sleeping, how can I do Puńyam? Can you? Yes, you can. What's the difference between habit and nature? When habit becomes one with your existence, it is called nature.

points.title: Suppose you are a teetotaller
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Suppose you are a teetotaller
summary: Suppose you are a teetotaller.
Finally, alcohol will be drinking you, you won't be drinking it.
By constant practice or under pressure of circumstances, one becomes habituated, and by encouraging this habituation, it finally becomes nature.
points.body: Suppose you are a teetotaller. What is the meaning of “teetotaller”? Now, a friend offered you some alcohol, then after three days, the friend offered you another glass of alcohol and you accepted it. After that it is your habit that you won't be able to be without alcohol. Then it is a habit. Finally, alcohol will be drinking you, you won't be drinking it. That is why the doctor will tell you to stop it. Everyone will tell you to stop because you have become helpless. It has become your nature. By constant practice or under pressure of circumstances, one becomes habituated, and by encouraging this habituation, it finally becomes nature.

points.title: This is auto-suggestion
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: This is auto-suggestion
summary: This is auto-suggestion.
Try to make it what – habit or nature?
And I want that all of you should make it your nature also.
points.body: This is auto-suggestion. “Now it is time for my meditation”, what is it? You are trying to habituate yourself. But when you cannot live without puja, then it has become your nature. Try to make it what – habit or nature? Nature. I never take a drop of water without doing puja. Why? It has become my nature. And I want that all of you should make it your nature also.

points.title: When auto-suggestion will become your nature, what will happen?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: When auto-suggestion will become your nature, what will happen?
summary: When auto-suggestion will become your nature, what will happen?
Automatically there will be japa.
Be engaged in doing Puńya all 24 hours.
points.body: When auto-suggestion will become your nature, what will happen? While sleeping you will be repeating that japa (repetition of mantra) in your unconscious mind. You are sleeping, so conscious mind is not active. You are not having any dream, so your sub-conscious mind is also not active. But unconscious mind is there. Automatically there will be japa. 24 hours you are doing Puńya. While you are sleeping, you will be engaged in doing japa and using your incantation. Kuru puńyam Ahorátram. Be engaged in doing Puńya all 24 hours.

points.title: And you should always encourage the company of Satsauṋga – those who are engaged in Pu…
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: And you should always encourage the company of Satsauṋga – those who are engaged in Puńya
summary: And you should always encourage the company of Satsauṋga – those who are engaged in Puńya.
Pratyaváya means not to do the “dos” of life.
There are two kinds of Pátaka.
points.body: And you should always encourage the company of Satsauṋga – those who are engaged in Puńya. And always avoid the Sauṋga of Pátakiis-those who are engaged in Pátaka. That company will deprave the people, degenerate the people. Among Pátaka, there are two classes, two branches. One is Pápa, the other is Pratyaváya. Pápa means to do the “don'ts” of life. Don't steal. If you steal, it will be Pápa because you are doing the “don'ts” of life. Pratyaváya means not to do the “dos” of life. You should help a man in distress. You should help the suffering humanity. These are the dos of life. If you do not do them, you are doing Pratyaváya. Pápa plus Pratyaváya is Pátaka. There are two kinds of Pátaka.

points.title: Always be engaged in Puńya and always avoid Pátaka
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Always be engaged in Puńya and always avoid Pátaka
summary: Always be engaged in Puńya and always avoid Pátaka.
Never be with those people who are engaged in Pátaka.
Pátakiis will give you negative outer suggestion, and their suggestions are detrimental to the progress of the human society.
points.body: Always be engaged in Puńya and always avoid Pátaka. Always try to be with those people who are engaged in Puńya. Never be with those people who are engaged in Pátaka. This is because these Puńyavána people who are engaged in Puńya will give you outer suggestion, good outer suggestion, positive outer suggestion. Pátakiis will give you negative outer suggestion, and their suggestions are detrimental to the progress of the human society.

points.title: What is this?
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: What is this?
summary: ” How could you say that it is a flower?
You never see anything, you never hear anything, you never even touch anything.
At that time, you feel that you are seeing the flower, or you feel that you are hearing some song, or you feel that you are touching something hot or cold.
points.body: What is this? What is this? “It is a flower.” How could you say that it is a flower? Because particular light waves come and touch your eyes, and a similar flower is created in your mind. Actually, you are not seeing the flower; you are seeing the mental image of the flower within. Do you follow? You never see anything, you never hear anything, you never even touch anything. When you see something or touch something, the corresponding sympathetic vibration is created within your mind. At that time, you feel that you are seeing the flower, or you feel that you are hearing some song, or you feel that you are touching something hot or cold.

points.title: In fact, you never come in physical contact with anything
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: In fact, you never come in physical contact with anything
summary: In fact, you never come in physical contact with anything.
Your contact with everything is through your mind, through your nerve fibres, through your nerve cells, and your entire objective mind.
When you feel you see, it is an internal projection with the help of your nerves.
points.body: In fact, you never come in physical contact with anything. Your contact with everything is through your mind, through your nerve fibres, through your nerve cells, and your entire objective mind. When you feel you see, it is an internal projection with the help of your nerves.

points.title: What a mystery!
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: What a mystery!
summary: It is a great mystery that whatever you perceive or whatever you conceive – everything is within you, nothing is outside of you.
You are seeing the psychic projection of the material world, which is why I say that the human entity is more psychic than physical.
But, in DMC, I said that you must maintain parallelism between your entitative waves, incantative waves, and spiritual waves.
points.body: What a mystery! It is a great mystery that whatever you perceive or whatever you conceive – everything is within you, nothing is outside of you. That is why it is said that the entire universe is within you in miniature form. You are seeing the psychic projection of the material world, which is why I say that the human entity is more psychic than physical. Your existence is more important in the psychic world than in the physical world. But, in DMC, I said that you must maintain parallelism between your entitative waves, incantative waves, and spiritual waves.

points.title: Human approaches are of two kinds – extro-internal and intro-external
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Human approaches are of two kinds – extro-internal and intro-external
summary: Human approaches are of two kinds – extro-internal and intro-external.
This movement is from external to internal.
This is the subject of applied psychology.
points.body: Human approaches are of two kinds – extro-internal and intro-external. Here is a flower. The waves move from the external world to the eye, then through the optic nerve to the nerve cells and finally to the brain. There, a similar flower is created inside the mind according to the light waves that are outside your body. This movement is from external to internal. It is something external, and its creation is in your mind, that is external to internal. Extro-internal – created outside but going within. This is the subject of applied psychology.

points.title: There may also be intro-external movement, created within the mind and sent outside
points.prompt: Define and explain: There may also be intro-external movement, created within the mind and sent outside
summary: There may also be intro-external movement, created within the mind and sent outside.
That external projection can be seen by you and by others.
In the language of psychology, it is called a “positive hallucination”.
points.body: There may also be intro-external movement, created within the mind and sent outside. Suppose you have created an elephant within your mind, and you have got a strong ectoplasmic structure. With the help of this strong ectoplasmic structure, you create sympathetic vibrations outside. That external projection can be seen by you and by others. In your mind, you are creating an ectoplasmic elephant, and that elephant is projected outside. Others may see it. In the language of psychology, it is called a “positive hallucination”.

points.title: Similarly, suppose there is an external elephant, and with the help of your ectoplasmic…
points.prompt: Define and explain: Similarly, suppose there is an external elephant, and with the help of your ectoplasmic power, you withdraw the light wa
summary: Similarly, suppose there is an external elephant, and with the help of your ectoplasmic power, you withdraw the light waves emanating from the external elephant.
In psychology, this is called a “negative hallucination.
” A positive hallucination means that what appears to exist does not exist, and a negative hallucination means that what actually exists appears not to exist.
points.body: Similarly, suppose there is an external elephant, and with the help of your ectoplasmic power, you withdraw the light waves emanating from the external elephant. Everyone will see there is no elephant, although actually there is an elephant. In psychology, this is called a “negative hallucination.” A positive hallucination means that what appears to exist does not exist, and a negative hallucination means that what actually exists appears not to exist. Have you understood?

points.title: Now, for you there are two worlds, the external world and the internal world
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Now, for you there are two worlds, the external world and the internal world
summary: Now, for you there are two worlds, the external world and the internal world.
In order to create positive hallucinations or negative hallucinations, there is always extroversial projection of your thought-waves.
It is a very nice, interesting and intellectual subject.
points.body: Now, for you there are two worlds, the external world and the internal world. Waves from the outside enter the internal world, and ectoplasmic waves with a strong pressure may create strong extroversial waves. In order to create positive hallucinations or negative hallucinations, there is always extroversial projection of your thought-waves. It is a very nice, interesting and intellectual subject.

points.title: But for Parama Puruśa what happens?
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: But for Parama Puruśa what happens?
summary: But for Parama Puruśa what happens?
In that case, he will become one with Parama Puruśa.
When he becomes one with Parama Puruśa, there is no Mr.
points.body: But for Parama Puruśa what happens? Who is Parama Puruśa? Parama Puruśa means He who, with His ectoplasmic force, is creating everything. When a man has got devotion, he may or may not be a scientist, but he may unify his existence with Parama Puruśa because of his extreme love for Parama Puruśa. In that case, he will become one with Parama Puruśa. At that time he maintains no separate identity. Suppose, the name of the man is Mr. Joseph. When he becomes one with Parama Puruśa, there is no Mr. Joseph.

points.title: So, Parama Puruśa is one
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: So, Parama Puruśa is one
summary: So, Parama Puruśa is one.
Whoever will be in love with Him, in close contact with Him, will also become Parama Puruśa.
One becomes absorbed, just like the Huang Ho.
points.body: So, Parama Puruśa is one. You, little girl, can you dance? Yes. Can you sing? Yes. Are you an expert in painting? Yes. Can you speak French? No. Now you have one weakness. So everybody has got certain imperfections. Parama Puruśa has got two imperfections. One is that He cannot create a second Parama Puruśa. Whoever will be in love with Him, in close contact with Him, will also become Parama Puruśa. But Parama Puruśa remains one. Magnet and iron. When iron comes in contact with the magnet, the iron and magnet become one entity. So, Parama Puruśa remains one. Have you heard the name Huang Ho? What happens when it comes in contact with the Pacific Ocean? When a person comes in contact with Parama Puruśa, one does not remain a person. One becomes absorbed, just like the Huang Ho.

points.title: Parama Puruśa has got two imperfections
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Parama Puruśa has got two imperfections
summary: Parama Puruśa has got two imperfections.
” But Parama Puruśa cannot hate anyone.
“Either you change your name or withdraw your order.
points.body: Parama Puruśa has got two imperfections. He cannot create a second Parama Puruśa. Parama Puruśa is always one. The second imperfection is that He cannot hate anyone. Suppose you dislike a person. You will say, “I do not want to see your face. I hate you.” You may say this if you are dissatisfied. You may also say, “Get out! Get out!” But Parama Puruśa cannot hate anyone. If Parama Puruśa hated you what might He say? “Get out! Get out!” Then you may challenge Him. “Parama Puruśa, you are everywhere, and yet you order me to get out. Where will I go?” Then Parama Puruśa will have to say, “Go outside my area.” But outside there is nothing. Everything is inside. So then you will challenge Parama Puruśa. “Either you change your name or withdraw your order.” Do you follow?

points.title: So, Parama Puruśa cannot do two things
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: So, Parama Puruśa cannot do two things
summary: So, Parama Puruśa cannot do two things.
All are His creation.
So Parama Puruśa cannot hate.
points.body: So, Parama Puruśa cannot do two things. He cannot create a second Parama Puruśa, and he cannot hate anyone. He cannot even hate a bad person. All are His creation. Suppose in your mind you have created a drunkard, a bad man. You cannot hate that man because he is within your mind. So Parama Puruśa cannot hate.

points.title: Now I was saying that for you, there are two worlds, the external world and the interna…
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Now I was saying that for you, there are two worlds, the external world and the internal world
summary: Now I was saying that for you, there are two worlds, the external world and the internal world.
He has created the ocean within His mind, and mentally He is seeing it.
Everything is internal.
points.body: Now I was saying that for you, there are two worlds, the external world and the internal world. For you, there are extro-internal vibrations and intro-external vibrations. But for Parama Puruśa, everything is within, everything is internal. Nothing is without, nothing is external. So for Him, there can neither be extro-internal projection nor intro-external projection, because everything is within, nothing is external. So whatever He thinks in His mind, others see as real. You see the Pacific Ocean externally, but for Parama Puruśa, the Pacific Ocean is within His mind. He has created the ocean within His mind, and mentally He is seeing it. Seeing mental objects requires no eyes. If you create a tiger in your mind, do you require any eyes to see it? You will mentally be seeing the tiger you created. For seeing anything Parama Puruśa requires no eyes. He sees with His mental eyes. For Him, there is nothing external. Everything is internal.

points.title: Now what will an intellectual do?
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Now what will an intellectual do?
summary: Now what will an intellectual do?
Can they become one with Parama Puruśa?
Those who have intellectual vanity will never be able to come in close contact with Him.
points.body: Now what will an intellectual do? Many learned people are puffed up with vanity. Have you seen some scholars who have much vanity, who are proud of their intellect? You have seen such people. Can they become one with Parama Puruśa? Never, because their psychic projection is towards the external world. They want to get more name and fame, to establish themselves in the arena of vanity. Those who have intellectual vanity will never be able to come in close contact with Him.

points.title: Those who are established in actional faculties will be engaged in action
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Those who are established in actional faculties will be engaged in action
summary: Those who are established in actional faculties will be engaged in action.
It is a relative change of place and not an absolute one.
So, by dint of one's actional faculties, one cannot get Him.
points.body: Those who are established in actional faculties will be engaged in action. What is action? Action means relative change of place. When there is a change of place, you will say that an action is being done. It is a relative change of place and not an absolute one. Those who are engaged in actional faculties are doing so with time, space and person, but Parama Puruśa is beyond the periphery of time, space and person. So, by dint of one's actional faculties, one cannot get Him.

points.title: Then who can get Him?
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Then who can get Him?
summary: Then who can get Him?
” But you are to do one thing.
– because the entire universe is within His mind, so all the properties of the universe are His.
points.body: Then who can get Him? They say it is very, very easy. What to do? “O Lord, I am Your creation. I am Yours, I am at Your disposal. This body is a machine. Utilize it.” But you are to do one thing. What? Is there any want in Parama Puruśa? There are two imperfections. He cannot create another Parama Puruśa and cannot hate anybody, but is there any want in Him? There is no want – name, fame, money, etc. – because the entire universe is within His mind, so all the properties of the universe are His. He has no want.

points.title: But the true devotee says, “Oh Parama Puruśa, there are so many great devotees, and I…
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: But the true devotee says, “Oh Parama Puruśa, there are so many great devotees, and I am only an ordinary devotee, the
summary: But the true devotee says, “Oh Parama Puruśa, there are so many great devotees, and I am only an ordinary devotee, the worst devotee.
His mind has been taken by His devotees.
I offer my mind to You.
points.body: But the true devotee says, “Oh Parama Puruśa, there are so many great devotees, and I am only an ordinary devotee, the worst devotee. But Lord, those who are your big devotees have done one thing. They have stolen Your mind.” Because Parama Puruśa loves His devotees very much, His mind has been stolen by them. Now Parama Puruśa's mind has been stolen by His devotees, so He has got one want – mind. His mind has been taken by His devotees. “Oh Lord, your devotees have stolen your mind, so You have got one want. You have lost your mind. Do one thing, Lord, take my mind. Let there be no want in You. I offer my mind to You. Accept it.”

points.title: So the devotees are very intelligent, they are more intelligent than intellectuals, and…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: So the devotees are very intelligent, they are more intelligent than intellectuals, and more intelligent than those enga
summary: So the devotees are very intelligent, they are more intelligent than intellectuals, and more intelligent than those engaged in actional faculties.
points.body: So the devotees are very intelligent, they are more intelligent than intellectuals, and more intelligent than those engaged in actional faculties.

points.title: Do you know what a saying is?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Do you know what a saying is?
summary: Do you know what a saying is?
And what is a letter?

Similarly, the acoustic wave, which means the expression of sound, also comes from the very source, from the very nucleus, from the very controlling point of the universe – who, we say, is Parama Puruśa.
points.body: Do you know what a saying is? It is a collection of words. And what is a word? A collection of syllables. And what is a syllable? A collection of letters. And what is a letter? A [sound having a] particular wavelength, or a particular acoustic expression. Everything comes out of the Supreme Entity, so many waves of light, sound, so many waves of tactual vibration… Ssh! – hot! Tssh! – very cold! These are all tactual variations having different wavelengths. Similarly, the acoustic wave, which means the expression of sound, also comes from the very source, from the very nucleus, from the very controlling point of the universe – who, we say, is Parama Puruśa.

points.title: Sounds are innumerable
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Sounds are innumerable
summary: Sounds are innumerable.
The same vowel or same consonant may have so many sounds.
All these are Latin words.
points.body: Sounds are innumerable. Say, the English letter “a”. In the English language this sound “a” has twenty-two types of pronunciation. A-N-T, “ant”. But E-L-E-P-H-A-N-T “eleph-ent”, not “eleph-ant”. Here, A-N-T is not “ant” but “ent”. The same A-N-T will be pronounced ant [“ahn”] in French, elephant [“elephahn”]. The same vowel or same consonant may have so many sounds. Even in the case of the pictorial expression of sound, a particular figure may be pronounced in a particular way in Mandarin, in a particular way in Shanghailese, in a particular way in Cantonese, in a particular way in North Japan, in a particular way in South Japan. So many expressions, innumerable expressions, of human vocality. “Acoustic” means “pertaining to –” – what? The Latin term for “concerning sound” is “acoustic”, and for “concerning ear”, “auricular”; “concerning eye”, “ocular”; “concerning seeing”, “optical”. All these are Latin words.

points.title: These many expressions are all sacred
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: These many expressions are all sacred
summary: These many expressions are all sacred.
All languages are certainly sacred.
All have the same dignity.
points.body: These many expressions are all sacred. All sounds are sacred, no sound can be bad, because all come from that Entity. All human expressions are certainly sacred. All languages are certainly sacred. That is why I pay respect, I pay reverence, to all languages of the world. All have the same dignity.

points.title: Now if we try to bring those expressions – so many expressions – together, it will be b…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Now if we try to bring those expressions – so many expressions – together, it will be beyond human capacity, but we may
summary: Now if we try to bring those expressions – so many expressions – together, it will be beyond human capacity, but we may try.
And as a result of human endeavour, those expressions have been brought within the range of fifty main sounds.
Those fifty main sounds are controlled by fifty main glands and sub-glands of the human body.
points.body: Now if we try to bring those expressions – so many expressions – together, it will be beyond human capacity, but we may try. And as a result of human endeavour, those expressions have been brought within the range of fifty main sounds. Those fifty main sounds are controlled by fifty main glands and sub-glands of the human body.

points.title: In the morning span I was saying something regarding the pancreas
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: In the morning span I was saying something regarding the pancreas
summary: In the morning span I was saying something regarding the pancreas.
Amongst the fifty sounds, ten are controlled by the pancreas – d́a, d́ha, ńa, ta, tha, da, dha, na, pa, and pha.
These ten sounds control ten propensities of the human mind – shyness, fear, etc.
points.body: In the morning span I was saying something regarding the pancreas. There are ten sub-glands; each and every sub-gland has a particular sound. Amongst the fifty sounds, ten are controlled by the pancreas – d́a, d́ha, ńa, ta, tha, da, dha, na, pa, and pha. Each and every sound has something to do with the physical world and with the mental world. These ten sounds control ten propensities of the human mind – shyness, fear, etc.

points.title: Suppose all those sounds are expressed at one time
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Suppose all those sounds are expressed at one time
summary: Suppose all those sounds are expressed at one time.
But if you go, say, about one hundred yards from the market, what will be the sound?
That collective sound is aum, A-U-M.
points.body: Suppose all those sounds are expressed at one time. What will happen? Suppose you go to a market. Somebody will say, “What's the rate of potato?” Somebody else will say, “What's the rate of brinjal [eggplant]? What's the rate of meat?” – like this. And the shopkeeper will say, “I want this much;” and the customer will say, “No, no, no, I won't give more than that.” So many sounds. But if you go, say, about one hundred yards from the market, what will be the sound? Something like “hawawawawa”. All the sounds together will create a peculiar collective sound, is it not a fact? Will you hear “potato” or “beans” or “cauliflower” from a distance? No, you hear the collective sound “hawawawawa”. Is it not a fact? Similarly, all those sounds, innumerable sounds, brought under the broad category of fifty, will create a collective sound in the universe. That collective sound is aum, A-U-M.

points.title: Now listen to these three sounds of aum
points.prompt: Define and explain: Now listen to these three sounds of aum: a, u, ma
summary: Now listen to these three sounds of aum: a, u, ma.
So all those innumerable sounds, all those fifty sounds, are represented by these supreme sounds, a, u and ma; and collectively a-u-ma becomes aum.
That supporting sound is called the acoustic root of that action.
points.body: Now listen to these three sounds of aum: a, u, ma. They represent the creation, the retention [or preservation], and the destruction. The first sound, a, represents creation; the second sound, u, represents retention; the third sound, ma, represents destruction. So all those innumerable sounds, all those fifty sounds, are represented by these supreme sounds, a, u and ma; and collectively a-u-ma becomes aum. For each and every action there is a supporting sound in this universe. That supporting sound is called the acoustic root of that action.

points.title: You are moving
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: You are moving
summary: The sound khat́-khat́-khat́-khat́ is created.
That sound, khat́-khat́-khat́, is the acoustic root of the action of moving.
That sound, khat́-khat́-khat́, is the acoustic root of the action of moving.
points.body: You are moving. The sound khat́-khat́-khat́-khat́ is created. That sound, khat́-khat́-khat́, is the acoustic root of the action of moving.

points.title: You are laughing
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: You are laughing
summary: The sound há-há-há-há is created.
The sound há-há-há is the acoustic root of the action of laughing.
Each and every action has its acoustic root.
points.body: You are laughing. The sound há-há-há-há is created. The sound há-há-há is the acoustic root of the action of laughing. Each and every action has its acoustic root.

points.title: The portion of the tree that remains under the earth is the root; the acoustic root is…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: The portion of the tree that remains under the earth is the root; the acoustic root is the sound which may be treated as
summary: The portion of the tree that remains under the earth is the root; the acoustic root is the sound which may be treated as the rudimental portion of an action.
The Latin adjective of “root” is “rudimental”.
For each and every action of this world there is an acoustic root.
points.body: The portion of the tree that remains under the earth is the root; the acoustic root is the sound which may be treated as the rudimental portion of an action. The Latin adjective of “root” is “rudimental”. For each and every action of this world there is an acoustic root.

points.title: You see, tantra
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: You see, tantra
summary: The root tan means “to expand”, and tra means “liberator”.
It is a very interesting science.
But I must be paid for it!
points.body: You see, tantra. The root tan means “to expand”, and tra means “liberator”. The science that liberates you from all bondages, physical, mental and spiritual, is Tantra. Tan means “expansion” and tra means “liberator”. The science that expands your mind and spirit and thus liberates you is Tantra. The metamorphosed form of tantra about seven thousand years ago became taota. The Sanskrit dhyána became c'han [in Chinese], c'han became chen [in Korean], chen became zen [in Japanese]. It is a very interesting science. Now, tantra became taota; taota after further distortion, further metamorphosis, became taoa – in modern language [Chinese], tao. Taoism, don't you know? Its root is tantra. Do you relish this topic? Do you like what I am saying? But I must be paid for it! [Everybody laughs.]

points.title: So then for all the universe, the acoustic side is aum – A-U-M
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: So then for all the universe, the acoustic side is aum – A-U-M
summary: So then for all the universe, the acoustic side is aum – A-U-M.
It includes all the spheres of work also.
It is the collective sound of all the work of the universe.
points.body: So then for all the universe, the acoustic side is aum – A-U-M. It includes all the spheres of work also. It is the collective sound of all the work of the universe.

points.title: The earth moves around the sun; certainly a sound is created
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: The earth moves around the sun; certainly a sound is created
summary: The earth moves around the sun; certainly a sound is created.
Everywhere there is sound.
That light may or may not be visible to you.
points.body: The earth moves around the sun; certainly a sound is created. It may or may not be audible to you, you may or may not hear it, but certainly a sound is created. The moon moves around the [earth]; certainly waves are created, and certainly due to those waves, sounds are also created. It may or may not be audible to you. Everywhere there is sound. If you move stealthily, as the cat moves while catching a mouse, even then there is sound. Everywhere there is wave; everywhere there is light also. That light may or may not be visible to you.

points.title: In the night you cannot see, but owls can see, moles can see – Moles, you know?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: In the night you cannot see, but owls can see, moles can see – Moles, you know?
summary: In the night you cannot see, but owls can see, moles can see – Moles, you know?
It lays no eggs; it is a mammal.
Aum represents the mundane expression of Parama Puruśa; aum represents the worldly expression of Parama Puruśa.
points.body: In the night you cannot see, but owls can see, moles can see – Moles, you know? Rat-like creatures of small size… for example, “to make a mountain out of a molehill”. Moles can see in the night. Owls can see in the night. Bats can see in the night. The bat is neither bird nor animal, it is a mammal. It lays no eggs; it is a mammal. It can see in the night, so there is light. Aum is the collection of all sounds, so within the scope of aum come all the activities of the world. For each and every work there is sound; aum is the collection of all sounds. So within the scope of aum comes all the work of the world. Aum represents the mundane expression of Parama Puruśa; aum represents the worldly expression of Parama Puruśa.

points.title: In each and every human being there is sleeping divinity, divinity in latent form, divi…
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: In each and every human being there is sleeping divinity, divinity in latent form, divinity in dormant form
summary: In each and every human being there is sleeping divinity, divinity in latent form, divinity in dormant form.
A person will acquire immense power.
The person is Parama Puruśa, because the sleeping divinity has been aroused.
points.body: In each and every human being there is sleeping divinity, divinity in latent form, divinity in dormant form. When that sleeping divinity is aroused, stops sleeping, is in a wakeful stage, what happens? A person will acquire immense power. He or she may become omniscient, all-knowing – will know everything, without going through any book, without going to any library – will know everything of this universe, because that person will be one with Parama Puruśa. The person is Parama Puruśa, because the sleeping divinity has been aroused.

points.title: The sleeping divinity in the human body lies in the lowermost portion of your backbone
points.prompt: Define and explain: The sleeping divinity in the human body lies in the lowermost portion of your backbone
summary: The sleeping divinity in the human body lies in the lowermost portion of your backbone.
Kuńd́alinii means “in coiled form”.
One will become Parama Puruśa.
points.body: The sleeping divinity in the human body lies in the lowermost portion of your backbone. That lowermost bone is called kula in Sanskrit. That sleeping divinity is called kulakuńd́alinii. Kuńd́alinii means “in coiled form”. It is sleeping, and when it is aroused, is elevated, by dint of your sádhaná, by dint of your dhyána, c'han, chen, zen, it will go upwards. When it comes up, that is, touches the controlling point of the pineal gland, one will become one with Parama Puruśa. One will become Parama Puruśa.

points.title: Now the spot, the kula, where divinity is in sleeping form, is found in each and every…
points.prompt: Define and explain: Now the spot, the kula, where divinity is in sleeping form, is found in each and every human being
summary: Now the spot, the kula, where divinity is in sleeping form, is found in each and every human being.
When by Tantra and yoga it is aroused and brought upwards by applying a special force, that special force is called diipanii.
Raising it, elevating it, it finally becomes one with Parama Puruśa when it comes here [crown of the head].
points.body: Now the spot, the kula, where divinity is in sleeping form, is found in each and every human being. When by Tantra and yoga it is aroused and brought upwards by applying a special force, that special force is called diipanii. Raising it, elevating it, it finally becomes one with Parama Puruśa when it comes here [crown of the head].

points.title: Now the seat where the kula is, the seat where the kulakuńd́alinii is, has got existen…
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Now the seat where the kula is, the seat where the kulakuńd́alinii is, has got existence, and wherever there is any act
summary: Now the seat where the kula is, the seat where the kulakuńd́alinii is, has got existence, and wherever there is any action or there is any existence, there is acoustic root.
(Because of your presence, air, light, everything – every expression's flow – is barred, the flow is checked.
) The existence of the seat of that kula, where that kulakuńd́alinii, that coiled serpent, sleeps, also has an acoustic root, and there is a certain psychic place allotted for it.
points.body: Now the seat where the kula is, the seat where the kulakuńd́alinii is, has got existence, and wherever there is any action or there is any existence, there is acoustic root. There is a sound for it. (Because of your presence, air, light, everything – every expression's flow – is barred, the flow is checked. You are standing here; air comes; because of your existence, it will refract or reflect; so your existence also has got a certain sound.) The existence of the seat of that kula, where that kulakuńd́alinii, that coiled serpent, sleeps, also has an acoustic root, and there is a certain psychic place allotted for it.

points.title: That psychic spot is called in old Sanskrit mańipadma, or mahámańipadma, or munipadm…
points.prompt: Define and explain: That psychic spot is called in old Sanskrit mańipadma, or mahámańipadma, or munipadmá or mahámunipadmá
summary: That psychic spot is called in old Sanskrit mańipadma, or mahámańipadma, or munipadmá or mahámunipadmá.
Mahámuni means “great sage”.
I remember that entity also.
points.body: That psychic spot is called in old Sanskrit mańipadma, or mahámańipadma, or munipadmá or mahámunipadmá. (Mahámuni is a name of Lord Buddha. Mahámuni means “great sage”.) So, “Using aum, I remember Parama Puruśa; and mańipadma is the seat of that coiled serpentine, that sleeping divinity, in the human body. I remember that entity also.” ( 1 )

points.title: There are so many sounds
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: There are so many sounds
summary: There are so many sounds.
” “I want to eat jackfruit.
You prepare different pictures in your mind, so the waves will also be different.
points.body: There are so many sounds. Each and every thing has got some sound. Suppose you want to learn. A particular vibration is created, “I want to learn, I want to learn.” A vibration is created. The meaning of the vibration is, “I want to learn.” The vibration of this desire is a mental flow. “I want to do something.” “I want to eat jackfruit.” “I want to eat – ” – what? “Passion fruit.” [laughter] There are several different flows. “I want to eat mango” and “I want to eat pineapple” are not the same flow. In the case of “mango” there is a picture of a mango in your mind. In the case of “pineapple” there is another picture in your mind, a picture of a pineapple with small thorns. In “mango” there are no thorns. You prepare different pictures in your mind, so the waves will also be different.

points.title: You want to fight against so many weaknesses
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: You want to fight against so many weaknesses
summary: You want to fight against so many weaknesses.
Do you follow everything?
The hummm sound is the acoustic root of fight.
points.body: You want to fight against so many weaknesses. The human mind has so many weaknesses. The doctor says, “You see, you are suffering from liver disease, you must not take oil. You must not take butter.” It is human weakness. There are so many human weaknesses. “Bábá ( 2 ) says I should fast on Ekádashii day, so I am fasting on Ekádashii and secretly taking chocolate.” Bábá knows this, but Bábá won't say anything. Simply, when you come before Bábá during P.C., then in Personal Contact Bábá will say, “O my little boy, can you explain to me what's the actual taste of chocolate?” And if that person has intellect he will understand. Do you follow everything? [Laughter. One Márgii, in particular, becomes red-faced.] According to mental desire, there are acoustic roots, there are sounds. Each and every man has certain weaknesses; one is always moving after name, one is always moving after fame, or after money, always money so many weaknesses. One wants to fight against internal and external enemies. You have enemies in your mind, you have enemies outside your mind. There are so many depraving forces, they are all your enemies. When you want to fight against the mind, a particular flow is created in your mind, a particular flow. The acoustic root of that flow is hummm. [Makes fighting gesture.] The hummm sound is created. The hummm sound is the acoustic root of fight.

points.title: When you are to raise your sleeping divinity, elevate the sleeping divinity from the lo…
points.prompt: Define and explain: When you are to raise your sleeping divinity, elevate the sleeping divinity from the lowermost bone of your body, the ma
summary: When you are to raise your sleeping divinity, elevate the sleeping divinity from the lowermost bone of your body, the mańipadma, the lowermost seat, you will also fight against so many adversities and pass through the entire cord, the entire backbone of your body.
Parama Puruśa touches the human body through this point [crown of the head].
It is called Brahmarandhra.
points.body: When you are to raise your sleeping divinity, elevate the sleeping divinity from the lowermost bone of your body, the mańipadma, the lowermost seat, you will also fight against so many adversities and pass through the entire cord, the entire backbone of your body. After so many fights, you will be able to elevate the sleeping divinity in your body to the status, or to the stance, of Parama Puruśa. Parama Puruśa touches the human body through this point [crown of the head]. It is called Brahmarandhra.

points.title: Brahma means Parama Puruśa and randhra means “cord”, the cord through which Parama Pur…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Brahma means Parama Puruśa and randhra means “cord”, the cord through which Parama Puruśa touches the body
summary: Brahma means Parama Puruśa and randhra means “cord”, the cord through which Parama Puruśa touches the body.
One thousand propensities of the human mind are controlled by this pineal gland.

Now, just to raise the coiled serpentine, your sleeping divinity, you have to fight against many fetters, so many fetters of animality, so there is a fight, and this should be represented by the sound hummm.
points.body: Brahma means Parama Puruśa and randhra means “cord”, the cord through which Parama Puruśa touches the body. It is the pineal gland controlling all fifty – that is, fifty times two times ten – one thousand – propensities. One thousand propensities of the human mind are controlled by this pineal gland. By the pituitary gland only the conscious, subconscious and unconscious portions of your mind [are controlled]. Now, just to raise the coiled serpentine, your sleeping divinity, you have to fight against many fetters, so many fetters of animality, so there is a fight, and this should be represented by the sound hummm.

points.title: So the old Maháyániis used this incantation, Oṋḿ mańipadme hummm
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: So the old Maháyániis used this incantation, Oṋḿ mańipadme hummm
summary: So the old Maháyániis used this incantation, Oṋḿ mańipadme hummm.
I think perhaps the monks do not know, though they should know, the inner meaning of what they say.
I think it is very interesting and very pleasing, although it has been a bit terse.
points.body: So the old Maháyániis used this incantation, Oṋḿ mańipadme hummm. Now it is clear. I think perhaps the monks do not know, though they should know, the inner meaning of what they say. I think it is very interesting and very pleasing, although it has been a bit terse.

points.title: Last night I said something regarding extro-internal movements and also some thing rega…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Last night I said something regarding extro-internal movements and also some thing regarding positive hallucination and
summary: Last night I said something regarding extro-internal movements and also some thing regarding positive hallucination and negative hallucination.
It is only the devotees who reach the goal.
I didn't say much regarding their movement.
points.body: Last night I said something regarding extro-internal movements and also some thing regarding positive hallucination and negative hallucination. And I also said that intellectuals, by dint of their intellectual power won't be able to reach the goal, and that those engaged in actional faculties also can't reach the goal. It is only the devotees who reach the goal. I didn't say much regarding their movement.

points.title: Their movement is movement of pinnacled existence
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Their movement is movement of pinnacled existence
summary: Their movement is movement of pinnacled existence.
You love this thing, you love that thing.
There are multifarious projections of your existence.
points.body: Their movement is movement of pinnacled existence. Your existence is divided into so many projections. You like this thing, you like that thing. You love this thing, you love that thing. So your existence has been projected. There are multifarious projections of your existence.

points.title: For a man who always runs after money, what will happen when that money is lost?
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: For a man who always runs after money, what will happen when that money is lost?
summary: For a man who always runs after money, what will happen when that money is lost?
So it is said that the devotees are the most cunning fellows.
Devotees are the most cunning fellows.
points.body: For a man who always runs after money, what will happen when that money is lost? He will die. Sometimes, due to economic depression or devaluation, many people die because their existence was solely on money. But when your existence is pinnacled, that pinnacled existence comes in contact with the Supreme. So it is said that the devotees are the most cunning fellows. Who are the most cunning fellows? Devotees are the most cunning fellows. Others are fools.

points.title: But how is one to move along that path?
points.prompt: Define and explain: But how is one to move along that path?
summary: But how is one to move along that path?
These things are essential for human life.
So many times I have said, yours should be subjective approach with objective adjustment.
points.body: But how is one to move along that path? How is one's existence to be pinnacled? Human existence is trifarious – physical, mental, and spiritual, but the stages or layers are four in number – physical, psychic, psycho-spiritual, and spiritual. In Sanskrit those physical entities with which, we say, human existence is closely coordinated is called “Káma”. You cannot do without these things – food, clothing, education, medical treatment. These things are essential for human life. They come within the grasp of Káma, the lowest layer. Those that think that this world is nothing, or those who say that a good man should keep no connection with the world are in Fool's Paradise. Yet you should remember that these things should not be the goal of your life. So many times I have said, yours should be subjective approach with objective adjustment.

points.title: For your development in this crudest, physical layer, you should build up a strong soci…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: For your development in this crudest, physical layer, you should build up a strong society
summary: For your development in this crudest, physical layer, you should build up a strong society.
You should see that everyone gets enough food, clothing, housing, medical treatment, education, you should see to it.
It is your social duty.
points.body: For your development in this crudest, physical layer, you should build up a strong society. You should see that everyone gets enough food, clothing, housing, medical treatment, education, you should see to it. It is your social duty.

points.title: Just above Káma is Artha, pure psychic
points.prompt: Define and explain: Just above Káma is Artha, pure psychic
summary: Just above Káma is Artha, pure psychic.
The crudest one is physical, next is psychic.
It is called “Artha”.
points.body: Just above Káma is Artha, pure psychic. The crudest one is physical, next is psychic. It is called “Artha”. What is Artha?

points.title: When the psychic want is quenched, when the psychic thirst is quenched, when the psychi…
points.prompt: Define and explain: When the psychic want is quenched, when the psychic thirst is quenched, when the psychic hunger is satisfied, that quenc
summary: When the psychic want is quenched, when the psychic thirst is quenched, when the psychic hunger is satisfied, that quenching of thirst or satisfaction of hunger is called Artha, in psychic level, not in physical level.
In physical level, I have already said that it is called Káma.
In physical level, I have already said that it is called Káma.
points.body: When the psychic want is quenched, when the psychic thirst is quenched, when the psychic hunger is satisfied, that quenching of thirst or satisfaction of hunger is called Artha, in psychic level, not in physical level. In physical level, I have already said that it is called Káma. This is Artha.

points.title: In Sanskrit, Artha has got two meanings, two significances
points.prompt: Explain the contrast: In Sanskrit, Artha has got two meanings, two significances
summary: In Sanskrit, Artha has got two meanings, two significances.
One man will say, “Rudimental means 'fundamental'.
“Rudimental, rudimental.
points.body: In Sanskrit, Artha has got two meanings, two significances. One is purely psychic. Another is psychic but associated with physical. When it is purely psychic, the word Artha means “meaning”. “What is its Artha?” means “What is its meaning?” Another meaning of Artha is the object, the token, the entity with which you can quench your thirst, that is… Money! (laughter). There are two meanings of Artha. Artha functions in psychic level. So for a devotee, this movement will be from Káma, pointed towards Artha. The supreme point of Káma should merge, should be one with the stratum of Artha. There must not be any want in your mind. If you want to know the meaning of “rudimental”, you will ask, “What is the meaning of rudimental”. One man will say, “Rudimental means 'fundamental'.” If rudimental means fundamental, why are there two words? First, thirst of mind – “What is the meaning of 'rudimental'?” Somebody said that rudimental means fundamental. Then the second thirst, when rudimental means fundamental, why are there two words? Why not just say “fundamental”? Then a new thirst is created in the mind. Unless and until this thirst is quenched, there won't be any mental concentration. [Baba pretends to meditate – Publisher.] What's the difference? It is a psychic thirst. During your Iishvara prańidhána, you are doing the prańidhána not of Iishvara, but of “rudimental”. “Rudimental, rudimental.” Is it not a fact?

points.title: Then how is that thirst to be quenched?
points.prompt: Define and explain: Then how is that thirst to be quenched?
summary: Then how is that thirst to be quenched?
These thirsts are of mind, and mind has got so many flows, so many propensities, so many propulsions.
It means “getting the way to Dharma.
points.body: Then how is that thirst to be quenched? It is for those intellectual fools. Ordinary devotees won't have this type of thirst. My thirst is quenched, my throat is quenched. Then one man will say that “fundamental” means concerning the base, and “rudimental” means concerning the root. This is psychic. Have you understood? Unless and until all these thirsts are quenched, there cannot be concentration. So what is a devotee to do? These thirsts are of mind, and mind has got so many flows, so many propensities, so many propulsions. You have to withdraw all these propensities and goad them to a higher level. Again it is to be pinnacled, and that point is to come into contact with spiritual level. When it is from psychic level to spiritual level, the movement is psycho-spiritual. This psycho-spiritual movement is the third phase. It is called Dharma. In Pali, Dhamma, in Sanskrit Dharma. That is why Lord Buddha used the word Abhidhamma for initiation. It means “getting the way to Dharma.”

points.title: Now, this psycho-spiritual movement is withdrawal of all propensities
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Now, this psycho-spiritual movement is withdrawal of all propensities
summary: Now, this psycho-spiritual movement is withdrawal of all propensities.
It starts from the psychic level and ends in the spiritual.
This is purely internal.
points.body: Now, this psycho-spiritual movement is withdrawal of all propensities. It concerns the psychic body, but movement of the collective propensities is something psycho-spiritual. It starts from the psychic level and ends in the spiritual. A devotee has got nothing to do with intro-external or extro-internal activities. This is purely internal.

points.title: In the first phase, it is physical, the projection of physicality on mind
points.prompt: Define and explain: In the first phase, it is physical, the projection of physicality on mind
summary: In the first phase, it is physical, the projection of physicality on mind.
The fourth stage is purely spiritual.
It is called mokśa or parinirvańa – both are Sanskrit words.
points.body: In the first phase, it is physical, the projection of physicality on mind. In the second phase, pure psychic; in the third phase, psycho-spiritual, known as Dharma. The fourth stage is purely spiritual. It is called mokśa or parinirvańa – both are Sanskrit words.

points.title: What is mokśa?
points.prompt: Define and explain: What is mokśa?
summary: Should one do anything for attaining mokśa?
Salvation means liberation of permanent nature.
It is to be used only in the case of spiritual liberty because in all other three spheres, physical, psychic, and psycho-spiritual, there can't be liberty of permanent nature.
points.body: What is mokśa? Should one do anything for attaining mokśa? The English term for mokśa is salvation. Not liberation, but salvation. Salvation means liberation of permanent nature. Emancipation of permanent nature is salvation. We must not use this term salvation for physical liberty or psychic liberty. It is to be used only in the case of spiritual liberty because in all other three spheres, physical, psychic, and psycho-spiritual, there can't be liberty of permanent nature. It is called mokśa.

points.title: For the attainment of mokśa what is one to do?
points.prompt: Describe the process: For the attainment of mokśa what is one to do?
summary: For the attainment of mokśa what is one to do?
“O Parama Puruśa, I offer this feeling of existence, I offer this mind at your feet.
It is the practice of mokśa.
points.body: For the attainment of mokśa what is one to do? That pinnacled psycho-spiritual existence of yours is to be offered at the altar of the Supreme. The dearest entity for each and every human being is his existence, is his feeling of existence. “O Parama Puruśa, I offer this feeling of existence, I offer this mind at your feet.” This is the practice of mokśa as taught by the ácáryas during dhyána (meditation). It is the practice of mokśa.

points.title: The day before yesterday, I said that the devotees are very cunning
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: The day before yesterday, I said that the devotees are very cunning
summary: The day before yesterday, I said that the devotees are very cunning.
Their approach is pinnacling from physicality to psychic existence, from psychic existence to psycho-spiritual, and finally to the stance of spirituality.
Extroversiality has got nothing to do with a devotee.
points.body: The day before yesterday, I said that the devotees are very cunning. They are certainly clever; not only clever, they are cunning too, because their approach is neither extro-internal nor intro-external. Their approach is pinnacling from physicality to psychic existence, from psychic existence to psycho-spiritual, and finally to the stance of spirituality. Extroversiality has got nothing to do with a devotee.

points.title: Last night what was the subject?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Last night what was the subject?
summary: Last night what was the subject?
In the first phase, it is physical, then psychic, then psycho-spiritual, and finally spiritual.
Káma, Artha, Dharma, and Mokśa.
points.body: Last night what was the subject? That the movement, the progress of a spiritual aspirant starts from the physical strata. In the first phase, it is physical, then psychic, then psycho-spiritual, and finally spiritual. Káma, Artha, Dharma, and Mokśa.

points.title: Now you know there is a theory that whenever there is an action, there is an equal and…
points.prompt: Define and explain: Now you know there is a theory that whenever there is an action, there is an equal and opposite reaction
summary: Now you know there is a theory that whenever there is an action, there is an equal and opposite reaction.
These three are called Tridańd́a in Sanskrit.
These are the fundamental relative factors.
points.body: Now you know there is a theory that whenever there is an action, there is an equal and opposite reaction. But, in the philosophy of Ananda Marga, this theory has been a bit changed. Whenever there is an action, there is an equal and opposite reaction, provided that the three fundamental relative factors remain unchanged. Whenever there is any change in any of these three fundamental relative factors, the reaction won't be equal to the action. These three fundamental relative factors are the spatial factor, temporal factor, and personal factor. These three are called Tridańd́a in Sanskrit. Tri means three in Sanskrit. T-R-I. Tri. In Latin also, tri-angle. Tridańd́a. Dańd́a means pillar or stand. In Latin, “triped”. These are the fundamental relative factors.

points.title: Whenever an action is done, in the next moment the temporal factor has changed
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Whenever an action is done, in the next moment the temporal factor has changed
summary: Whenever an action is done, in the next moment the temporal factor has changed.
When the reaction will start, it will be at least 12:01 or 12:02 So the time of the orginal action and the time of the reaction are not the same.
So time factor changes and the personal factor may or mav not change.
points.body: Whenever an action is done, in the next moment the temporal factor has changed. Say, at 12:00 an action has been finalized. When the reaction will start, it will be at least 12:01 or 12:02 So the time of the orginal action and the time of the reaction are not the same. They can never be the same. So time factor changes and the personal factor may or mav not change.

points.title: Suppose, you did something when you were a boy of five, and then the reaction comes whe…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Suppose, you did something when you were a boy of five, and then the reaction comes when you are a boy of 25
summary: Suppose, you did something when you were a boy of five, and then the reaction comes when you are a boy of 25.
There will be so many changes in your body.
So the personal factor also changes, the personal factor when the action was done, and the personal factor when the reaction comes.
points.body: Suppose, you did something when you were a boy of five, and then the reaction comes when you are a boy of 25. Are you the same boy? There will be so many changes in your body. So the personal factor also changes, the personal factor when the action was done, and the personal factor when the reaction comes.

points.title: Space also changes
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Space also changes
summary: The Earth's position in the Solar System is changing at every moment.
(Makes a circular movement with fingers).
The temporal, spatial, or personal factor must undergo changes.
points.body: Space also changes. The Earth's position in the Solar System is changing at every moment. The Sun with its solar system with all the planets and satellites, is moving in the vast space. The Sun is also not fixed, not stationary. It also moves along with its entire planetary system, along with its planetary order. Do you follow? And the relative distance between Earth and Sun also changes because the path is not circular. It is to some extent elliptical. (Makes a circular movement with fingers). The path is not circular, rather it is like this (Makes an elliptical movement with fingers). When the Earth is there or there, the distance is more than what it was when the Earth was here or here. So space also changes. For no action in this Universe does the reaction come without some change of time, space, or person. The temporal, spatial, or personal factor must undergo changes. Is it clear? Is it crystal-clear?

points.title: Whenever an action is done, its reaction can never be equal and opposite
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Whenever an action is done, its reaction can never be equal and opposite
summary: Whenever an action is done, its reaction can never be equal and opposite.
Say, he takes 100 Rupees.
Due to change in the temporal factor, he will have to pay some interest.
points.body: Whenever an action is done, its reaction can never be equal and opposite. There should be some change. Mr. X borrows some money from Mr. Y. Say, he takes 100 Rupees. During the repayment, he will have to pay 100 plus some interest because the time factor has changed, otherwise he would have repaid the equal amount. Do you follow me? Due to change in the temporal factor, he will have to pay some interest.

points.title: So in theory, the reaction should be equal and opposite, provided the three relative fa…
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: So in theory, the reaction should be equal and opposite, provided the three relative factors remain unchanged
summary: So in theory, the reaction should be equal and opposite, provided the three relative factors remain unchanged.
But surely there will be some change, so surely the reaction will not be equal and opposite.
That old theory that to each and every action there will be an equal and opposite reaction can not be supported now.
points.body: So in theory, the reaction should be equal and opposite, provided the three relative factors remain unchanged. But surely there will be some change, so surely the reaction will not be equal and opposite. That old theory that to each and every action there will be an equal and opposite reaction can not be supported now.

points.title: Now when should the reaction start?
points.prompt: Recall and explain from memory: Now when should the reaction start?
summary: Now when should the reaction start?
When he was a bad man, he was eating, drinking, and making merry, but as soon as he starts Sádhaná, he is to face so many obstacles, so many hardships.
He has become good, but be has to undergo so many troubles, so many problems.
points.body: Now when should the reaction start? Sometimes it may happen that a man was a degenerated man. When he was a bad man, he was eating, drinking, and making merry, but as soon as he starts Sádhaná, he is to face so many obstacles, so many hardships. He has become good, but be has to undergo so many troubles, so many problems.

points.title: What is this?
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: What is this?
summary: Do you follow what I said?
When it starts coming in the opposite Side when its upward movement ends and the downward movement starts.
The moment he becomes a good boy, becomes a Sádhaka, the reaction of his bad actions starts.
points.body: What is this? Why? Do you follow what I said? Why? The reason is that the pendulum moves. When it starts coming in the opposite Side when its upward movement ends and the downward movement starts. The moment he becomes a good boy, becomes a Sádhaka, the reaction of his bad actions starts.

points.title: Suppose there is a good man
points.prompt: Explain the reasoning: Suppose there is a good man
summary: Suppose there is a good man.
And now I am a bad man.
” When one asked Lord Buddha, “Why do good men suffer and bad men do not suffer, what is the reason?
points.body: Suppose there is a good man. The moment he becomes bad, the reaction of his good actions starts. He is quite happy. He says, “when I was a good man, I was suffering. And now I am a bad man. What! Mine is an easy life!” When one asked Lord Buddha, “Why do good men suffer and bad men do not suffer, what is the reason?” Buddha said.
